MspDiagSystemInfo.Description: Collects OS, uptime, pending reboot, CPU, BIOS/serial, TPM, Secure Boot, a Windows 11 readiness indicator, logged-on users, disks, network adapters, installed software, ipconfig /all and route print into a text report plus an HTML version.

MspDiagEventLog.Content: Export Critical Event Logs & Reliability Report
MspDiagEventLog.Description: Exports System/Application error and critical events (24h), saves a Reliability Monitor report (HTML + CSV, 30 days), and opens Reliability Monitor (perfmon /rel).

MspDiagNetwork.Description: Tests ping and DNS, shows public IP and proxy settings, checks TCP ports (443, DNS, optional 3389), shows Wi-Fi signal/band/rates (flags weak signal), and optionally runs a traceroute and saves the Windows WLAN report (admin).

MspDiagDiskHealth.Description: Reports disk health plus reliability counters per disk (temperature, wear, power-on hours, read/write errors) and SMART predictive failure; flags wear > 80%, temperature > 60C, uncorrected errors and unhealthy disks. Full counters need admin.

MspDiagReportView.Description: Lists reports saved by other tools (MSP-Reports folder) and MSP Tool logs to view or open, bundles them into a zip for a ticket, and deletes old reports (typed confirmation).

MspDiagAgentHealth.Description: Checks the CWA, ScreenConnect, ImmyBot, Defender and third-party EDR/AV agents are installed and running (status, start type, version, CWA check-in details) and offers to restart a stopped or disabled agent service (admin).

MspDiagPendingReboot.Description: Checks the standard pending-reboot indicators (CBS, Windows Update, pending file renames, computer rename, domain join, ConfigMgr), shows last boot time and uptime, and offers a restart only when one is pending.

MspDiagShutdownHistory.Description: 30-day timeline of unexpected shutdowns, dirty reboots (Kernel-Power 41), BSODs (with bugcheck code), user/process restarts and clean boots, with counts per type, a warning above 2 incidents, and optional CSV export.

MspDiagBatteryReport.Description: Shows battery charge, estimated runtime, design vs full-charge capacity (health %, flagged below 60%) and cycle count, and saves the Windows battery report (powercfg /batteryreport) as HTML.

MspDiagM365Health.Description: Read-only check of Microsoft 365 Apps: version, update channel, last update result, products, licensing and signed-in accounts, Outlook profiles and OST/PST sizes (flags large files), and classic vs new Teams.

MspDiagTicketBundle.Description: Zips recent MSP-Reports files (default last 24 hours, 0 = all) and MSP Tool logs with a summary.txt into Desktop\MSP-Reports\ticket-<COMPUTER>-<date>.zip, ready to attach to a ConnectWise ticket.

MspMaintTempCleanup.Description: Removes temp and cache files older than 7 days (Windows Temp, all users' Temp, Delivery Optimization, Chrome/Edge/Firefox cache folders - never cookies, history or passwords), shows a per-folder summary, and reports the size of C:\Windows.old.

MspMaintDiskCleanup.Description: Launches cleanmgr for system drive (silent preset where supported).

MspMaintOptimize.Description: Runs defrag/optimize on all fixed drives.

MspMaintWindowsUpdate.Description: Lists pending and recently installed updates.

MspSecDefenderScan.Description: Starts a quick malware scan with Microsoft Defender.

MspSecDefenderStatus.Description: Shows real-time and tamper protection, signature age, engine/platform versions, threat detections from the last 30 days, and exclusions (risky ones flagged).

MspSecFirewall.Description: Reports firewall state for Domain, Private, and Public profiles.

MspSecBitLocker.Description: Reports encryption status, method and protector types for all fixed drives, and whether the OS drive recovery key was backed up (Entra ID/AD/Microsoft account). Never shows recovery passwords.

MspSecLocalAdmins.Description: Lists local Administrators members, flags ones not on the allow-list, shows whether the built-in Administrator is enabled and Windows/legacy LAPS status, and can reset a selected local account password.

MspSecBaseline.Description: Read-only scorecard: SMBv1, RDP/NLA, UAC, Guest, AutoRun, Secure Boot, TPM, BitLocker, firewall, Defender, PowerShell v2, LLMNR, password/lockout policy, local admins, OS support, LSA protection, Credential Guard - PASS/WARN/FAIL with fix hints and an HTML copy.

MspSecRemoteAccessAudit.Description: Read-only scan of installed programs, services, processes and listening ports for remote-access/RMM tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk, Splashtop, VNC, other RMMs, extra ScreenConnect instances), marked APPROVED or UNAPPROVED.

MspSecFailedLogons.Description: Reviews the Security log (1/24/168 hours): failed logons by account, source, logon type and reason, account lockouts, and successful RDP logons; flags brute-force and password-spray patterns. Optional CSV export.

MspRepairSFC.Description: Scans and repairs protected system files. May take 15-30 minutes.

MspRepairDISM.Description: Repairs the Windows component store. Run before SFC if issues persist.

MspRepairNetworkReset.Description: Resets Winsock and IP stack. Requires reboot.

MspRepairSearchIndex.Description: Restarts Windows Search and triggers index rebuild.

MspRepairWindowsUpdateReset.Description: Shows Windows Update service state and cache sizes, then (typed YES) stops the update services, renames SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 to .old-<date> (never deletes) and always restarts the services. Restart recommended.

MspRepairPrinter.Description: Lists printers, queues, stuck jobs and Spooler status; clear stuck jobs, clear all jobs, restart the spooler, print a test page or set the default printer. Spooler actions need admin.

MspRepairQuickNetwork.Description: Lighter than Reset Network Stack: flush DNS, release/renew DHCP and register DNS (admin), then re-test gateway, DNS and HTTPS. No restart needed.

MspRepairOfficeCache.Description: Current user only: shows classic/new Teams and Outlook cache sizes (OST/PST never touched), closes the apps on request and clears the caches so they rebuild. Won't run as SYSTEM.

MspRepairOneDriveReset.Description: Current user only: shows OneDrive state and signed-in accounts, then restarts OneDrive or runs a full reset (typed YES; files are not deleted, sync re-scans). Won't run as SYSTEM.

MspSetupRestorePoint.Description: Creates a system restore point before making changes.

MspSetupTimeSync.Description: Restarts Windows Time service and forces NTP sync.

MspSetupRdpEnable.Description: Enables RDP and configures firewall rule for remote access.

MspSetupHostname.Description: Displays hostname, domain/workgroup, and serial number.

MspSetupWorkstationBaseline.Description: Shows current name, serial, time zone, power plan and apps, then lets you rename the computer, set time zone and power plan, remove consumer apps and install baseline apps via winget - each step confirmed. Settings in config\baseline.json.

MspDomainStatus.Description: Shows if the workstation is domain joined, the domain name, and secure channel health.

MspDomainConnectivity.Description: Tests DNS resolution, DC discovery, and LDAP port 389 reachability for a domain.

MspVpnStart.Description: Lists VPN connections found on the workstation, starts the selected one, then offers to rerun domain connectivity.

MspDomainCredentialTest.Description: Verifies a supplied credential can authenticate to the target domain before joining a workstation.

MspVpnChecker.Description: Lists visible VPN connections, shows connection status, and prompts which one to start.

MspDomainGpUpdate.Description: Runs gpupdate /force and shows applied GPO results.

MspDomainJoin.Description: Prompts for domain FQDN and admin credentials, verifies connectivity, then joins the domain.

MspDomainUnjoin.Description: Unjoins the workstation from the domain and joins a workgroup.

MspDomainSecureRepair.Description: Tests and repairs the machine account trust with the domain (fixes 'trust relationship failed').

MspDomainEntraStatus.Description: Summarises dsregcmd /status (Entra/hybrid/domain join, tenant, device certificate, PRT, Windows Hello, MDM) plus Intune enrollment, with a verdict, common-problem hints and an option to save the raw output.

MspPerfSpecCheck.Description: Evaluates SSD/HDD, RAM, CPU, and workstation age against LENET Techno Stack V3.0 recommendations.

MspPerfResourceSnapshot.Description: Current CPU and memory usage. Consistently > 90% indicates a performance issue.

MspPerfOpenResourceMonitor.Description: Launches resmon.exe to inspect CPU, Memory, Disk, and Network per process.

MspPerfTopProcesses.Description: Lists top resource-consuming processes. Helps identify Chrome, svchost, or other hogs.

MspPerfDismFull.Description: Runs dism scanhealth, checkhealth, and restorehealth. Screenshot each result.

MspPerfManufacturerInfo.Description: Shows serial number and links to Dell/HP/Lenovo support and driver updater tools.

MspPerfStartupAudit.Description: Lists startup programs from registry and Startup folder. You can select one to remove from startup.

MspPerfServicesAudit.Description: Lists running non-Microsoft services. Review before disabling in msconfig.

MspPerfClearUserTemp.Description: Clears %temp% folder per LENET procedure. Skips locked files.

MspPerfDiskSpaceCheck.Description: Warns if any drive has less than 20% free (causes slow startup and performance).

MspPerfRecentUpdates.Description: Lists updates installed in the last 30 days. Select one to uninstall (via DISM), or reinstall an update this tool removed earlier (via Windows Update). Cross-check CWA Patching History.
